title: COPASI Skills: Agent Skills for COPASI analyses through Basico
html:
Abstract:Biochemical models represent biological systems as networks of reactions that describe the production, consumption, and transformation of molecular species over time. These models provide a quantitative framework for analyzing system dynamics and enable computational experiments that complement traditional wet-lab approaches, helping researchers gain mechanistic insight and make predictive assessments of biological behavior. COPASI is a widely used program for simulating and analyzing those models. These tasks are made availabe to Python through Basico. COPASI Skills is a set of instruction files that tell an assistant how to drive Basico for one analysis at a time. Each skill is a directory containing a `this http URL` file. A short description at the top tells the assistant when the skill applies, and the rest of the file states which calls to make, which files to write, and which potential neighboring skill to choose additionally. A researcher can ask for example, in ordinary language, for a time course, a fit, or a published model. The assistant follows the matching skill and leaves tables or a report next to the model. The collection is released under a two-clause BSD license from [this https URL](this https URL).
